Classification-only map; F2P count 28; used only to label F2P/P2P ownership, not as coverage authority.
PASS requires exhaustive forward/reverse matrices, instruction/docs walks, F2P/P2P and output-interface walks, second omission sweep, and empty BLOCKING_FINDING_IDS.
Instruction owns the engineering ask; runbook/oncall/config remain legitimate technical documentation when not used as a second prompt or repair map.

findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: fold the phrase into “exactly one fenced writable writer” in instruction to match runbook live gates.

findings.criterion: Runbook sticky_seconds TTL is not expired in tests; coverage asserts pin publish, post-write writer confirmation, and lag-gated standby_readable.

findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: after sticky_seconds elapse with gap in budget, assert idle confirmation may use replica.

findings.criterion: test_p2p_zero_gap_budget_hides_tiny_lag only asserts max_lag_lsn exists in config/runbook; it does not vary the budget or hide tiny lag.
findings.why_it_matters: Name overclaims behavior already covered by F2P lag/watermark tests. Vacuous P2P relative to its title; not a phantom contract.
findings.minimal_remediation: Rename the P2P or add a budget-mutation assertion.

findings.criterion: test_f2p_epoch_and_pin_survive_reconnect grades durability after connections.close_all/caches.close_all without an explicit restart sentence in instruction/runbook.
findings.why_it_matters: Borderline extra invariant; still consistent with DB-backed fence lease and shared pins store required elsewhere. Correct conforming implementations pass.

findings.criterion: Second instruction paragraph densely enumerates functional gates that align closely with verifier families.
